item.title: C2PA only works if everything is signed
item.description: The European Union AI Act is Europe’s attempt to comprehensively regulate AI usage. A big part of that is the requirement that AI-generated content be identifiable: either tagged with a watermark or with what the Act calls “digitally signed metadata”1. Since all this becomes enforceable in a month, it’s worth figuring out if it makes any sense. I recently discussed AI watermarking at length in Text AI watermarks will always be trivial to remove. What about digitally signed metadata?
